achievements.name: Board Win
achievements.detail: Win a Mario Party board by holding the most Stars when the last turn ends.

achievements.name: Jamboree Buddy
achievements.detail: Win the Showdown minigame that starts when you pass a Jamboree Buddy so that ally joins you.

achievements.name: Pro Rules
achievements.detail: Win a Mario Party board played under Pro Rules.

achievements.name: Western Land
achievements.detail: Reach Silver player rank and win a party on Western Land.

achievements.name: Rainbow Castle
achievements.detail: Reach Gold player rank and win a party on Mario's Rainbow Castle.

achievements.name: Trek Stars
achievements.detail: In Party-Planner Trek, earn Mini Stars by finishing requests and minigame challenges on a board.

achievements.name: Trek Boss
achievements.detail: In Party-Planner Trek, defeat the boss that takes a board's Mini Stars and win them back.

achievements.name: Plaza Decor
achievements.detail: Unlock a decoration in Party-Planner Trek and place it in the Party Plaza.

achievements.name: Koopathlon
achievements.detail: Finish first in a Koopathlon race by winning minigames and completing the laps ahead of the field.

achievements.name: Kaboom Squad
achievements.detail: Win a Bowser Kaboom Squad game by loading the cannon and defeating Impostor Bowser.

achievements.name: Rhythm Kitchen
achievements.detail: Clear a Rhythm Kitchen set by cooking on the beat and earning a passing rating.

achievements.name: Bowser's Keep
achievements.detail: Reach Platinum player rank, or finish Party-Planner Trek and watch the credits, then win a party on King Bowser's Keep.
